source_type_scope: X,Z : RT_OR_ART_TYPED_OPERAND, exact source declaration unresolved
target_type_scope: ObservationOrientation_x(D_rel) : Type, retained as a provisional type parameter
source_context_scope: Y : SOURCE_COMPOSITION_CONTEXT, with mappings to B_x, D_rel, and R unresolved
governing_principle: Hypothesize an orientation-bearing aspect of a source operand; do not identify the source operand with an observation orientation.
prohibited_identity: X = o_i and Z = o_j are not admitted hypothesis forms.
threshold_independence_guard: Carrier-aspect existence is evaluated without D(X|Z) > epsilon_src.
Carrier-aspect relation to o is evaluated without d_obs(o_i,o_j) > epsilon_obs.
Threshold agreement may test a relation after construction but cannot establish the relation.
PASS/PASS is not evidence that a carrier mapping is valid.
FAIL/FAIL is not by itself evidence that a valid carrier mapping is absent.

hypotheses.source_type_scope: X or Z as an RT_OR_ART_TYPED_OPERAND with a potentially extractable orientation-bearing aspect
hypotheses.orientation_bearing_surface: A pre-RefOrient aspect a_x extracted from the operand under D_rel.
hypotheses.relation_definition_candidate: ExtractOrientAspect_x(X; D_rel) = a_x AND RelateOrientAspect_x(a_x, o; D_rel)
hypotheses.positive_condition: An independently declared extractor returns an orientation-bearing aspect and a governed relation relates that aspect to o.
hypotheses.negative_condition: A governed source operand of the declared type has no extractable orientation-bearing aspect under the active D_rel, or the governed aspect relation definitively rejects o.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: Source type, extractor, aspect semantics, target type, D_rel applicability, or dependency stage is unresolved.
hypotheses.falsification_case: A governed operand has the declared source type but a complete pre-RefOrient analysis proves that no orientation-bearing aspect can be extracted.
hypotheses.threshold_independence_statement: The extractor and aspect relation are evaluated before either source or observation distinction-floor comparison.

hypotheses.source_type_scope: X or Z carrying an independently declared source orientation class c_src
hypotheses.target_type_scope: o : ObservationOrientation_x(D_rel) carrying a target class c_obs
hypotheses.orientation_bearing_surface: A source orientation-class field and a separately typed observation-orientation class.
hypotheses.relation_definition_candidate: SourceOrientClass_x(X) = c_src AND ObsOrientClass_x(o) = c_obs AND ClassBridge_x(c_src, c_obs; D_rel)
hypotheses.positive_condition: Both class fields and the class bridge are independently declared, applicable, and pre-RefOrient.
hypotheses.negative_condition: A governed source/target class pair is defined and ClassBridge_x definitively rejects compatibility.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: No source class field, target class field, class bridge, applicability decision, or dependency evidence is governed.
context_dependencies: Y may index applicability but may not create the class bridge
hypotheses.falsification_case: A governed source and target class pair exists, but the governed class bridge definitively rejects the pair before threshold evaluation.
hypotheses.threshold_independence_statement: Class compatibility is evaluated without D(X|Z) > epsilon_src or d_obs(o_i,o_j) > epsilon_obs.

hypotheses.source_type_scope: X or Z with a governed complete source-type analysis
hypotheses.orientation_bearing_surface: Absence of an orientation-bearing aspect or authorized class/projection bridge.
hypotheses.relation_definition_candidate: NoOrientAspect_x(X; D_rel) AND NoApplicableCarrierRule_x(X, o; D_rel)
hypotheses.positive_condition: Not applicable; this is a non-relation candidate that can become definite only after rule-set completeness is established.
hypotheses.negative_condition: A complete governed analysis establishes no orientation-bearing aspect and no applicable authorized carrier rule.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: Rule-set completeness, source-type analysis, authority, provenance, or dependency stage is incomplete.
hypotheses.falsification_case: A governed orientation-bearing aspect or authorized applicable carrier rule is found for X and o.
hypotheses.threshold_independence_statement: No-relation classification is based on type/aspect/rule-set analysis, not on the result of the distinction-floor test.

hypotheses.source_type_scope: X or Z when exact source type or source-role declaration is unresolved
hypotheses.orientation_bearing_surface: Potential orientation-bearing structure cannot be decided from current source declarations.
hypotheses.relation_definition_candidate: CarrierRelation_x(X, o; Y, D_rel) remains UNDEFINED when required type, aspect, target, rule, provenance, or stage evidence is unresolved.
hypotheses.positive_condition: Not applicable while the required source-to-target evidence is unresolved.
hypotheses.negative_condition: Not applicable; unresolved evidence must not be coerced to NOT_REPRESENTED.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: Any required source type, target type, carrier rule set, authority, provenance, context mapping, or dependency completeness evidence is missing or unresolved.
hypotheses.falsification_case: Complete governed source, target, rule-set, provenance, and dependency evidence resolves the relation as either represented or not represented.
hypotheses.threshold_independence_statement: Undefined status is assigned before threshold evaluation and cannot be resolved by threshold agreement.
